name: Chemistry and Chemical Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official available requirements and 2027–28 deadlines. Funding amounts are qualified by the period explicitly published; confirm offer-specific terms.

documents: Academic transcripts from every college-level institution

english.toefl: 100 before January 21, 2026; 5.0 for tests on/after that date
english.note: Two-year scores; no MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. DET only when other exams unavailable; DET-only admits take TOEP. English-only US degree or foreign degree with sole English instruction recorded in WHED may exempt; other documentation not accepted. Programs/TA employment may set higher standards.

applicationFee.note: US applicants$135. Central waiver limited to listed graduate-preparation programs, not general financial need. Identify program/coordinator in application; participation verified. International applicants should confirm category eligibility. Chemistry additionally offers a small competitive hardship pre-application route: November 1, 2026 at 23:59 PST; selection not guaranteed, international eligibility must be confirmed. Full application still due December 1.

requirements.note: Bachelor in chemistry, biochemistry, physics for Chemical Physics, or related STEM major; undergraduate cumulative GPA at least 3.0, with major-course emphasis. Three recommendations; academic preparation/research fit assessed holistically. Department TOEFL threshold higher than central. Equivalent three quarters at 25% TA appointment required (two at 50% satisfies).

deadlines.label: General and fellowship
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 central table; follow earlier department closing rules.

funding.note: PhD support through TA/GSR guaranteed while satisfactory, timely progress maintained. Stipend, tuition/fees and health insurance available; TAs pay campus-based fees, approximately$188/quarter as published. No current stipend amount established.
